newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed little changed in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 603.08 dinar from 603.03 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 2.36 million dinars against 1.83 million dinars.
Coke bottler SFBT lost 3.88 dinars to 125.49 dinars. Amen bank eased 1.78 dinar to 57.39 dinars.
ATB bank was up 1.76 dinar to 60.47 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN gained 1.29 dinar to 44.51 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
